description: Provides financial assistance to farmer families including tenant farmers to support their agricultural input costs before the sowing season.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹13,500 per year per farmer family in three installments (₹7,500 in May, ₹4,000 in October, and ₹2,000 in January).
eligibility: Cultivator landowning farmers in Andhra Pradesh
Tenant farmers belonging to SC, ST, BC, and Minority communities
Must be registered on the Navasakam portal
documents: Pattadar Passbook / CCRC (Crop Cultivator Rights Certificate)
application_mode: Online via Grama / Ward Sachivalayam Portal

scheme_name: YSR Free Crop Insurance (YSR Uchita Fasal Bima)
description: A 100% state-funded crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities without requiring farmers to pay any premium.
benefits: Complete waiver of crop insurance premium; direct compensation for crop yield loss credited directly to bank accounts.
eligibility: All farmers cultivating notified crops in Andhra Pradesh
application_mode: Automatic coverage via e-Crop booking at Rythu Bharosa Kendras (RBKs)

scheme_name: YSR Sunna Vaddi Crop Loan Scheme
description: Encourages prompt repayment of agricultural credit by providing a 100% interest subvention on short-term crop loans.
benefits: Zero-interest crop loans up to ₹1,00,000 upon timely repayment within the stipulated bank schedule.
eligibility: Farmers in Andhra Pradesh who avail short-term crop loans up to ₹1 lakh from institutional banks and repay on time
application_mode: Direct credit settlement through participating commercial/cooperative banks

description: Establishes Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) at the Rythu Bharosa Kendra level to supply high-value agricultural machinery at subsidized rental rates.
benefits: 40% government subsidy and 50% bank loan support for purchasing machinery groups, tractors, and combine harvesters.
eligibility: Farmer groups, Rythu Mitra Groups, and SHGs registered under RBKs in Andhra Pradesh
application_mode: Online via YSR Yantra Seva App / RBK Level Processing

description: Provides direct financial assistance to women in rural farming communities to set up sustainable livestock, retail, and agri-business enterprises.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹18,750 per year (totaling ₹75,000 over 4 years) transferred directly to bank accounts.
eligibility: Women belonging to SC, ST, BC, and Minority communities aged between 45 and 60 years in Andhra Pradesh

description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems to improve water use efficiency, minimize soil erosion, and increase crop yields across drought-prone districts.
benefits: 100% subsidy for SC/ST farmers, 90% for small and marginal farmers, and 80% for general categories on drip and sprinkler setups.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Andhra Pradesh with access to a functional borewell or water source
application_mode: Online via APMIP Portal / RBK Centre

scheme_name: YSR Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK) Agri-Input Subsidy
description: Ensures direct supply of quality-certified seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides at subsidized rates directly at village-level centers.
benefits: 50% to 75% doorstep input subsidies on certified seeds and bio-fertilizers ordered via RBK digital kiosks.
eligibility: Registered cultivators in Andhra Pradesh using e-Crop booking at local RBKs
application_mode: In-person at local Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK)

scheme_name: YSR Animal Husbandry & Cattle Insurance Scheme
description: Provides financial support and livestock insurance coverage for milch cattle to secure dairy farmers against livestock mortality.
benefits: Subsidized insurance premium up to 80% and direct payouts up to ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 per insured head of cattle.
eligibility: Dairy farmers and cattle owners in Andhra Pradesh registered with local veterinary dispensaries
application_mode: Offline via Village Veterinary Assistant / RBK

scheme_name: AP Zero Budget Natural Farming (APZBNF / APCNF)
description: Encourages climate-resilient, chemical-free agriculture through community-managed natural farming practices and input grants.
benefits: Free training, bio-input preparation kits, Jeevamrutha preparation incentives, and organic certification support.
eligibility: Farmers in Andhra Pradesh committing land to chemical-free natural farming practices
application_mode: Offline via Community Resource Persons (CRPs) / RBK

description: Supports crop diversification by encouraging farmers to convert traditional field crops into oil palm plantations.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹29,000 per hectare for planting material, inter-cropping support, and micro-irrigation installation.
eligibility: Farmers in designated oil palm cultivation zones in Andhra Pradesh with guaranteed water availability
application_mode: Online via Department of Horticulture AP
